en.t: The sky had not yet begun to grow light.
The sky overhead was filled with stars.

units.source_text: 在星光的照耀下，一直通到山门前的这段石台阶，白晃晃地向前延伸c

en.t: Under the starlight, this stretch of stone steps leading all the way to the temple gate extended ahead in a pale gleam c

units.source_text: 四处都落上了巨大的泡树、梅树、松树的影子。

en.t: All around lay the shadows of huge paulownia trees, plum trees, and pine trees.

units.source_text: 影子融化在影子里，占据着整个地面。

en.t: Shadows melted into shadows, covering the entire ground.

units.source_text: 我穿了件有破口的毛衣，拂晓的冷空气从我的胳膊肘渗透了进来。

en.t: I was wearing a sweater with a tear in it, and the cold air of dawn seeped in through my elbow.
